limitations: User scores are reported rounded console and page values; no raw full-precision score arrays, answer text or API responses were provided.
The four-candidate exercise uses frozen Day 22 retrieval results and is not a new retrieval-quality evaluation.
The toy timing is one short-input observation, excludes model loading, and is not an end-to-end performance benchmark.
Automated page cases use controlled embeddings, controlled rerank scores and simulated answers; no real model or paid API calls were made by the assistant.
One promotion case deliberately scores the fourth RRF candidate highest to verify selection wiring; its ranking is not a quality finding.
Legacy Dense and RRF histories are injected for compatibility checks.
Historical Day 21 to Day 24 reports remain unchanged; shared tests now validate the current rerank pipeline.
The user confirmed page counts, final chunk IDs, sources, pages, old and new ranks, scores and elapsed time; answer correctness and improvement over the full evaluation set were not evaluated.
The 1.212-second page measurement excludes model loading and is one observation, not a stable latency benchmark. The earlier four-candidate script timing was not reported and remains null.
Pairs longer than the configured 512-token limit can be truncated; max length is not a character count.
English/digit-only BM25 tokenization, automatic citation validation and persistent chat limitations remain.
